E4Plus1.uk.description: The Feud: Phil's upset to lose his position of social chair to his nemesis Gil. When he learns that Luke is competing against Gil's kid at wrestling, it becomes a personal battle. (S5 Ep15)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Large Marge: Marge accidentally gets breast implants. (S14 Ep4/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Helter Skelter: The Simpsons' house must be fumigated after a hockey player gives Lisa his termite-infested stick. The only place they can find to live is in a reality TV show. (S14 Ep5/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Great Louse Detective: When someone tries to murder Homer, Chief Wiggum seeks help from someone who understands the mind of a killer: Sideshow Bob. (S14 Ep6/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Special Edna (a.k.a. Love and Marking): When Skinner stands up Mrs Krabappel to attend to his mother's whims, Bart nominates her for Teacher of the Year. (S14 Ep7/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Operation: Broken Feather: Peralta is upset to hear that Santiago is considering leaving the precinct to work with his nemesis 'the Vulture' in the Special Crimes Unit. (S1 Ep15)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Party: Captain Holt invites the entire squad over to his house to celebrate his birthday, but Peralta and Santiago make a bad impression on Holt's husband, Kevin. (S1 Ep16)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Haley's 21st Birthday: The family take Haley to a bar to celebrate her 21st birthday. Can Claire convince Haley to see her as a friend, rather than as her uptight mum? (S6 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Day We Almost Died: A near miss from a crash leaves everyone in the car either on edge or adopting a new 'live for the moment' mentality. (S6 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Big Guns: Claire's fury about the ugly boat on neighbours Ronnie and Amber's front lawn soon develops into all-out war. (S6 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Rash Decisions: Phil feels the teenage cold shoulder from Luke, and Andy - who's been hanging around a lot as Phil's apprentice - steps in as his new right-hand man. (S6 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Double, Double, Boy in Trouble: Bart switches places with his doppelganger Simon. But it turns out Simon's wealthy family are plotting against him. (S20 Ep3/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Dangerous Curves: Homer and Marge head to a log cabin for the weekend and reminisce about their early courtship. (S20 Ep5/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mypods and Broomsticks: Homer suspects that Bart's new friend's Muslim family are terrorists. Meanwhile, Lisa becomes addicted to downloading songs on her new Mypod. (S20 Ep7/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Treehouse of Horror XIX: Halloween special. Homer comes up against a murderous rigged voting machine. Lisa's Malibu Stacy car and a vengeful giant pumpkin get a bit deadly too. (S20 Ep4/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Tony tries to find the words for Diane's eulogy. Dodger and Theresa take their relationship to the next level. And a resident makes a discovery that stops them in their tracks.

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Selma's Choice: After Homer gets sick from a giant sandwich he's been eating for months, Selma steps in to take the kids to a new alcohol-based theme park. (S4 Ep13/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Married at First Sight USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: The couples 'celebrate' their one-month anniversaries, and some of them can't quite believe it's only been one month and not an eternity... (S9 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Celebs Go Dating
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: As the finale approaches, David and Coleen head to the farm with their dates, while Lucinda decides who meets her emotional and physical desires. (S15 Ep18/20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Student Leah's on her first ever date. Cheeky welder Daniel and student midwife Emily bond over their shared passion for romcoms. Pilot Antonia meets rugby player Pete. (S9 Ep9)
